name: Goat Cheese (Chèvre)
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated on SIBO diet as it's naturally lower in lactose than cow's milk cheeses. The aging process further reduces lactose content.
preparationTips: Choose plain varieties without added high-FODMAP ingredients like garlic or onion
Let come to room temperature for best flavor and spreading consistency
Store in refrigerator and use within 5-7 days of opening
Check labels for added prebiotics or inulin which would increase FODMAP content
nutritionalHighlights: Lower in lactose than cow's milk cheese
